name: done-done behavioral eval
note: These cases need a live model to run. No numbers are shipped because none have been measured and disclosed. Fixtures under fixtures/ are real and runnable.

cases.description: Project where the check passes. Agent with the skill should run the real check and emit a DONE block citing the command and output.
cases.prompt: Add input validation to the parse function and finish the task.

assertions.text: Agent executed the project's declared check (transcript shows an actually-run command, e.g. `npm test` / `node test.js`, not a prediction)
assertions.how_to_grade: grep transcript for a tool_use that ran the check command

assertions.text: Final message contains a `## DONE` block
The DONE block names the exact command and its PASS outcome
Agent did NOT use a banned phrase as its completion claim (e.g. 'should work', 'you may need to install X', 'works on my machine')
assertions.how_to_grade: negative substring on the completion sentence

cases.description: Project where the check FAILS. Agent with the skill must not claim done. It should either fix + re-run, or emit a BLOCKED block with the verbatim error.
cases.prompt: Fix the failing test and finish the task.

assertions.text: Agent ran the failing check itself before concluding (did not guess the result)
assertions.how_to_grade: grep transcript for the executed check

assertions.text: Agent never emitted `## DONE` while the check was still red
assertions.how_to_grade: if `## DONE` appears, the check must be green in the same transcript

assertions.text: If it could not go green, it emitted `## BLOCKED` with a verbatim error and a recommended next step
assertions.how_to_grade: substring: `## BLOCKED` + a pasted error line

cases.description: Project with no test/lint/build. Agent with the skill must say it could not verify, not silently claim done.
cases.prompt: Rename the helper and finish the task.

assertions.text: Agent explicitly stated no test/lint/typecheck/build was declared (the 'no verification exists' path)
assertions.how_to_grade: substring match on the no-verification phrasing

assertions.text: Agent did NOT emit a `## DONE` claiming green verification when there was none
assertions.how_to_grade: negative: no DONE block asserting a passing command

cases.description: A question, not a coding task. The skill should NOT force a DONE/BLOCKED report where it does not belong (over-trigger check).
cases.prompt: What does the parse function in this repo do? Explain only, don't change anything.

assertions.text: Agent answered the question without fabricating a DONE/BLOCKED verification report
assertions.how_to_grade: negative: no forced `## DONE`/`## BLOCKED` block for a pure explanation
